description: Reads the AIGROW Score of one business on an AI Visibility Index page: of the answers the assistants gave to buyer questions for its category and place (ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini on every page, Grok on some), how many named it, out of 100, with the 95% interval the page publishes, the earlier edition, each assistant's own score and the names each one gave most. It reads published counts only: no website is read and no assistant is asked. A business the page does not list reads 0, and a name that fits several listed businesses returns them instead. Category and place are matched as ai_index_lookup matches them.

category.description: The kind of business, for example "dentist", "Zahnarzt" or "crm".

language.description: The language to answer in, as an ISO 639-1 code: en, de, fr, es, pt, it, nl, pl, sv, da or no. Any other code answers in English.

name.description: The business name, as the Index page writes it or a shorter or longer form of it, such as the legal name.

place.description: A city or a country, for example "Berlin", "Milano" or "Germany".

name: get_score
title: AIGROW Score
